patients.summary: Woman in her late twenties who joined in 2021 healthy, then developed schizophrenia in 2023 that failed two antipsychotics before clozapine; also degenerative high myopia, genito-pelvic pain/penetration disorder, Tay-Sachs carrier status, factitious disorder found at an ED visit, a clozapine-associated seizure, psychogenic polydipsia with hyponatremia, and a relapse off clozapine in 2026 with a psychiatric admission. Records from outside care arrive late or not at all.

documents.title: New patient intake call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is the patient. Wants to establish care, moving her primary care over from her old office (she says they stopped taking her plan). Medicaid card on file, verified active. New patient slot given for 9/14 at 9:30. Release signed electronically through the portal; request for the last three years of records sent to the prior office today. Reminded her to bring her glasses prescription and any medication bottles. She says she takes nothing regularly.

social.value: Lives with husband in her sister's household

procedures.procedure: Office visit, new patient, low MDM

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
NEW PATIENT

26 y/o woman here to set up primary care. No active complaints. Coming from another office; records requested 8/30, not here yet.

PMH: none she knows of. Nearsighted, glasses since she was a kid; hasn't had an eye exam in a little while.
PSH: none.
Meds: none. Occasional acetaminophen for headache, rarely.
Allergies: none to medications.

Family: mother treated for major depression. Father very nearsighted, had a retinal detachment repaired years ago. She thinks someone on one side had a stroke but can't say who. An uncle on mom's side has schizophrenia. Sister healthy. Mom's family is Ashkenazi Jewish.

Social: works full time as an administrative assistant at an office in town. Married. She and her husband live with her older sister, the house is the sister's. Never smoked, doesn't drink, no drug use. Medicaid.

ROS: negative across the board on a written questionnaire, reviewed with her.

Exam: vitals in flowsheet, all normal. Slim, well appearing, pleasant, a little quiet. Wearing thick glasses. HEENT unremarkable, neck supple, no thyroid enlargement. Heart RRR without murmur. Lungs clear. Abdomen soft, nontender. No edema. Skin unremarkable where examined. Mood fine, affect appropriate.

PHQ-9 2, GAD-7 3.

A/P
1. Health maintenance, new patient. Baseline CBC, CMP, lipids, TSH. One-time HIV and hep C screening offered and accepted. Pap per old records (she thinks one was done last year). Flu shot next month when stock is in; she has had her COVID primary series per her card.
2. Family history of stroke, noted. Nothing to do at her age with normal BP.
3. Myopia, longstanding. Suggested she get back to an eye doctor this year.

Follow up for a physical in the spring.

documents.title: Your lab results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Sharon, everything from Tuesday's blood work came back normal: blood counts, kidney and liver tests, thyroid and cholesterol. The HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Nothing to change. Nice meeting you.

documents.title: Records from prior primary care office
documents.author: MA
documents.body:
Prior primary care records received, 14 pages, covering 2018 to 2021. Abstracted for the PCP:
- Pap cytology 2020: negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.
- Tdap given 2019.
- COVID-19 vaccine primary series documented 2021 (card copy in file).
- No chronic problems listed. No medications. NKDA.
- Visits were mostly for colds and a work physical form.
Nothing further requested. Immunization history updated from these records.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Influenza Vaccine
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Here after work for her flu shot. Screening questions negative, no egg or vaccine reactions in the past, feels well today. Quadrivalent influenza 0.5 mL IM, left deltoid. VIS given. Stayed 15 minutes, no reaction.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Physical. Feels fine. Working, busy season at the office. Sleeping okay. No new symptoms.

She never got to the eye doctor; says her glasses still work well enough. Encouraged again.

Meds none. NKDA. Social unchanged, never smoker, no alcohol.

Exam: BP and weight in flowsheet, normal. Well appearing. Eyes: thick corrective lenses, pupils equal and reactive. Oropharynx clear. Neck without nodes or thyromegaly. Heart regular, no murmur. Lungs clear throughout. Abdomen soft, no masses or tenderness. Extremities without edema. Mood euthymic, speech normal rate.

Screens: PHQ-9 1, GAD-7 2.

Plan
- Labs last fall normal; no repeat needed this year.
- Pap last done 2020, normal; due again in 2023.
- Tdap 2019, current.
- Flu and COVID booster in the fall.
- Eye exam, yearly, she will call.

Return one year.

documents.title: Nurse Visit - Fall Vaccines
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Came in with her sister. Flu (quadrivalent) 0.5 mL IM left deltoid, Pfizer bivalent COVID booster 0.3 mL IM right deltoid. Screening negative. Patient was quiet and let her sister answer most of the questions; said she was tired. Observed 15 min, tolerated well. Mentioned to her she is due for a physical in the spring.
